references.heading: Projects delivered for the State, local authorities and businesses
references.body1: Since 2017, HikView Engineering has designed, installed and commissioned complete solutions: residential and professional electronic security, digital networks and infrastructure, management and point-of-sale solutions, audiovisual and collaborative solutions, IoT and Smart City.
references.body2: As a public-project (B2G) integrator, we support ministries, municipalities, healthcare and education institutions, national media and private companies across Tunisia, with more than 320 references. Every project combines supply, installation and commissioning, backed by a warranty and responsive after-sales support.
